attempts.summary: Configured HAProxy on node1 (an OPNsense/FreeBSD appliance) to load-balance TCP port 80 on its management/LAN address (10.100.183.10) across httpd instances on node2 (10.100.183.11:8080) and node3 (10.100.183.12:8080), each identifying itself by hostname. Verified node4 receives alternating responses from both backends through the single entry point. All four managed nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity changes confirmed and full service/data/pool recovery verified after each restart.
